cs.AI / 1 / 2610.17266
RL Post-Training Diffusion Language Models Along Their Own Generation Paths
沿其自身生成路径对扩散语言模型进行强化学习后训练
Vaibhav Singh, Eugene Belilovsky
cs.AI
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Diffusion language models are a promising and more efficient alternative to autoregressive models. However, most RL post-training techniques are not easily adapted to these models. One issue is that diffusion language models generate answers through many intermediate states, deciding at each step which masked positions to reveal and which tokens to place in them. Many existing RL methods used in this setting approximate intractable sequence likelihoods or weight every denoising step by the same advantage, without explicitly distinguishing how these intermediate states of the denoising trajectory affect the expected reward. To address this issue of trajectory blindness, we introduce PACT (Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions). Motivated by a reward-tilted reference distribution, PACT jointly learns the policy and a scalar potential that scores each intermediate state, anchored by terminal reward. For each sampled denoising transition, a consistency loss matches the policy-to-reference log-probability ratio of revealed tokens to the change in this potential. This formulation requires neither sequence-likelihood estimation nor importance-ratio clipping. On four tasks, PACT improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct by +9.9 points on GSM8K, +12.0 on MATH500, +55.7 on Countdown, and +72.6 on Sudoku, and reaches the best average accuracy across the four tasks reported for this model, +3.7 points over the next best method. Further compared to AGRPO, it reaches that baseline's best accuracy in about half the training compute on GSM8K.
Chinese Translation
扩散语言模型是自回归模型的一种有前景且更高效的替代方案。然而，大多数强化学习后训练技术并不容易适配这些模型。一个问题是，扩散语言模型通过许多中间状态生成答案，在每一步决定要揭示哪些被掩码的位置以及在这些位置放置哪些词元。在这一设定下使用的许多现有强化学习方法，要么近似难以处理的序列似然，要么用相同的优势值对每个去噪步骤进行加权，而没有明确区分去噪轨迹的这些中间状态如何影响期望奖励。为了解决这种轨迹盲视问题，我们提出了 PACT（Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions，势锚定的转移一致性）。受奖励倾斜的参考分布启发，PACT 联合学习策略以及一个对每个中间状态进行打分的标量势函数，并以终端奖励作为锚定。对于每个采样的去噪转移，一致性损失将被揭示词元的策略与参考分布的对数概率之比与该势函数的变化相匹配。这一形式既不需要序列似然估计，也不需要重要性比率裁剪。在四个任务上，PACT 使 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 在 GSM8K 上提升 +9.9 个点，在 MATH500 上提升 +12.0，在 Countdown 上提升 +55.7，在 Sudoku 上提升 +72.6，并达到了该模型所报告的四个任务上的最佳平均准确率，比次优方法高出 +3.7 个点。进一步与 AGRPO 相比，它在 GSM8K 上以大约一半的训练算力就达到了该基线的最佳准确率。

cs.AI / 2 / 2610.17305
Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
在资源受限环境中通过迭代重试工作流使用小型 LLM 实现可靠的 Text-to-SQL
Bilel Abderrahmane Benziane, Xavier Schepler
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved Text-to-SQL generation, but their computational cost can hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper evaluates the Text-to-SQL capabilities of small and medium open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) under a controlled inference budget, focusing on how model specialization and prompt formulation affect performance. Using the Spider benchmark, we compare multiple prompt representations and assess the accuracy of generated queries. Our results show that SQL-specialized models are consistently more reliable than general-purpose and chat-oriented models at small scales, and that performance can vary substantially depending on the prompt used. To reduce this variability without resorting to larger models, we introduce three lightweight inference workflows that automatically retry with alternative prompts and/or models when failures occur, including an optional syntax-correction step. These workflows significantly improve end-to-end success rates, with a trade-off in additional inference calls. These results demonstrate a practical path to stronger Text-to-SQL performance with small LLMs, by trading modest additional inference cost for higher reliability.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型（LLM）最近改进了 Text-to-SQL 生成，但其计算成本可能阻碍在资源受限环境中的部署。本文在受控推理预算下评估了小型和中型开源 LLM（1B-8B 参数）的 Text-to-SQL 能力，重点关注模型专门化和提示表述如何影响性能。使用 Spider 基准，我们比较了多种提示表示，并评估生成查询的准确性。我们的结果表明，在小规模下，SQL 专用模型始终比通用模型和面向聊天的模型更可靠，并且性能可能会因所使用的提示而有显著差异。为了在不诉诸更大模型的情况下减少这种变异性，我们引入了三种轻量级推理工作流，它们在发生失败时自动使用替代提示和/或模型进行重试，并包括一个可选的语法纠正步骤。这些工作流显著提高了端到端成功率，代价是额外的推理调用。这些结果展示了一条使用小型 LLM 获得更强 Text-to-SQL 性能的实用路径，即通过以适度的额外推理成本换取更高的可靠性。

cs.AI / 3 / 2610.17310
Beyond Successful Play: Diagnosing Opponent Modeling in Large Language Models
超越成功的博弈：诊断大型语言模型中的对手建模
Hanbo Xie, Yue Zhao, Robert C. Wilson
cs.AI · q-bio.NC
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Language-model agents are expected to adapt to others whose behavior changes through interaction. Yet adaptation may rely on learned behavioral patterns rather than theory of mind (ToM): the ability to infer others' mental states, including beliefs and intentions. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic framework for repeated hide-and-seek against algorithmic opponents with explicitly defined recursive belief updates. Their ground-truth beliefs and action probabilities let us distinguish adaptive play, action prediction, and belief tracking through live interaction, fixed-history evaluation, and controlled information interventions. With structured elicitation and behavioral supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we find improved play in several tested settings, but diagnostics reveal limitations in opponent prediction and belief tracking. We test whether supervising opponent action probabilities can address this predictive deficit in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Predictions improve when the model is told the opponent's type and parameter settings, but become less accurate when it must infer the opponent from history without this information. Training on examples that also omit these details reduces the gap, although improvements vary across opponents. Is this limitation specific to smaller open-weight models, or does it also appear in a frontier model? GPT-5.4 also benefits from correct opponent beliefs: supplying them improves its predictions and choices, whereas deeper explicit belief reports and self-generated memory do not consistently improve forecasting from interaction history. This contrast suggests that using useful belief information is easier than inferring it autonomously, even for a frontier model. Together, our findings distinguish improved play and action prediction from reliable belief tracking, providing a framework for evaluating mentalizing and testing targeted improvements.
Chinese Translation
语言模型智能体被期望能够适应那些行为会通过交互而发生变化的其他智能体。然而，适应可能依赖于习得的行为模式，而不是心理理论（ToM）：即推断他人心理状态（包括信念和意图）的能力。我们引入了一个基准和诊断框架，用于与具有明确定义的递归信念更新的算法对手进行重复捉迷藏。它们的真实信念和动作概率使我们能够通过实时交互、固定历史评估和受控信息干预来区分适应性博弈、动作预测和信念追踪。通过结构化引导和行为监督微调（SFT），我们在若干测试设置中发现了博弈表现的提升，但诊断结果揭示了在对手预测和信念追踪方面的局限。我们测试了监督对手动作概率是否能够解决 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 中的这一预测缺陷。当模型被告知对手的类型和参数设置时，预测会改善；但当它必须在没有这些信息的情况下从历史中推断对手时，预测会变得不那么准确。在同样省略这些细节的样本上进行训练会缩小这一差距，尽管改进因对手而异。这一局限是小型开放权重模型所特有的，还是也会出现在前沿模型中？GPT-5.4 也能从正确的对手信念中受益：提供这些信念会改善其预测和选择，而更深入的显式信念报告和自生成记忆并不能持续改善基于交互历史的预测。这种对比表明，使用有用的信念信息比自主推断它更容易，即使对于前沿模型也是如此。总之，我们的发现将改进的博弈表现和动作预测与可靠的信念追踪区分开来，为评估心理化和测试有针对性的改进提供了一个框架。

cs.AI / 4 / 2610.17401
Generalizable field of view extension for diffusion MRI via conditional flow matching
基于条件流匹配的可泛化扩散 MRI 视野扩展
Gaurav Rudravaram, Lianrui Zuo, Ema Topolnjak, Michael E. Kim, Adam M. Saunders, Elyssa M. McMaster, Paula Trujillo, Ely E. Wesley, Colin D. McKnight, Pratik P. Pandharipande, Mayur B. Patel, Cayce Strength, Brenda T. Pund, Amelia W Maiga, Robert S. Dittus, David A. Bennett, Julie A. Schneider, Konstantinos Arfanakis, The HABS-HD Study Team, Derek B. Archer, Timothy J. Hohman, Yelena Bodien, Daniel C. Moyer, Kurt G. Schilling, Bennett A. Landman
cs.AI
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Incomplete field-of-view (FOV) diffusion MRI (dMRI) acquisitions compromise whole-brain white matter analysis by excluding brain regions from tractography and connectivity studies. While deep generative models for dMRI FOV extension have been proposed, their generalizability remains limited by the acquisition-dependent nature of dMRI, where signal intensity varies with b-value, gradient direction, and scanner protocol, and the inherent 4D complexity of the data, making it difficult to train models that transfer across sites or acquisition schemes without retraining. We propose a flow-matching generative model that extends the dMRI FOV in both the superior and inferior directions by predicting apparent diffusion coefficients (ADC) in six directions, conditioned on the two nearest acquired slices and the full-FOV T1w image to enforce both local diffusion continuity and anatomical consistency. The ADC representation decouples the model from acquisition-specific b-values and gradient directions, providing a middle-ground across protocols. The model was trained on 3,103 subjects (5,105 sessions) across five different datasets spanning diverse acquisition schemes (b = 500 and 1000 s/mm$^2$; 21--192 gradient directions), four single-shell (b = 1000) and one multi-shell (b = 500/1000). Evaluated on 299 subjects across five independent datasets spanning b = 750--1500 s/mm$^2$ and 32--90 gradient directions, with single- and multi-shell schemes unseen during training, the proposed method achieves significantly improved bundle Dice score on downstream tractography (p < 0.01).
Chinese Translation
不完整的视野（FOV）扩散 MRI（dMRI）采集会将脑区从纤维束成像和连接研究中排除，从而损害全脑白质分析。虽然已经提出了用于 dMRI FOV 扩展的深度生成模型，但其泛化性仍然受限于 dMRI 的采集依赖性质，即信号强度随 b 值、梯度方向和扫描仪协议而变化，以及数据固有的 4D 复杂性，这使得难以训练无需重新训练即可跨站点或采集方案迁移的模型。我们提出了一种流匹配生成模型，该模型以两个最近的已采集切片和全 FOV T1w 图像为条件，通过预测六个方向上的表观扩散系数（ADC），在上、下两个方向上扩展 dMRI FOV，以同时保证局部扩散连续性和解剖一致性。ADC 表示将模型与采集特定的 b 值和梯度方向解耦，为不同协议提供了一种折中方案。该模型在来自五个不同数据集的 3,103 名受试者（5,105 次会话）上训练，这些数据集涵盖多种采集方案（b = 500 和 1000 s/mm$^2$；21--192 个梯度方向），四个单壳（b = 1000）和一个多壳（b = 500/1000）。在来自五个独立数据集的 299 名受试者上进行评估，这些数据集涵盖 b = 750--1500 s/mm$^2$ 和 32--90 个梯度方向，且训练期间未见过单壳和多壳方案，所提出的方法在下游纤维束成像上实现了显著改善的纤维束 Dice 分数（p < 0.01）。

cs.AI / 5 / 2610.17436
SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
SchemaWeaver：通过模式引导的并行LLM解码加速端侧移动智能体AI
Boyuan Yang, Wei Gao
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. SchemaWeaver can be generically applied to the LLM inference engine on mobile devices without involving any training efforts or changes on LLMs, and our experiment results on major mobile SoCs and LLM families show that SchemaWeaver can reduce the LLM tool calling latency by up to 3.9 times, compared to the competitive baselines.
Chinese Translation
移动设备上的大语言模型（LLM）可以作为智能体，调用外部软件工具来完成复杂任务，但用LLM支持端侧移动智能体AI的主要挑战在于移动设备上LLM工具调用的长延迟。特别地，解码阶段是造成这种长延迟的主要因素，但由于其受限于内存带宽而非算力，因此在移动处理器上难以加速。为了解决这一局限，本文提出了SchemaWeaver，一种新的端侧移动智能体AI技术，它在LLM工具调用的解码阶段强制执行模式引导的并行解码，通过在每个解码轮次中生成多个token来降低其延迟。SchemaWeaver可以通用地应用于移动设备上的LLM推理引擎，而无需任何训练工作或对LLM进行任何改动；我们在主流移动SoC和LLM系列上的实验结果表明，与具有竞争力的基线相比，SchemaWeaver最多可将LLM工具调用延迟降低3.9倍。

cs.AI / 6 / 2610.17439
Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions
大型语言模型扩展已知研究，但不创造新的研究方向
Zhihua Liu, Kurt Butler, Damian Machlanski, Danilo Bueno, Sotirios A. Tsaftaris
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
The success of autonomous research systems relies on the quality of the scientific hypotheses they generate. Recent studies report that human reviewers often rate LLM-generated ideas as more novel than those from human experts, raising hope that AI can accelerate scientific discovery. Yet it is unclear whether these models can do more than extend existing knowledge. Can LLMs drive genuine innovation by revealing new research directions, or are they limited to repeating and recombining what science already knows? This unresolved question lies at the heart of discussions about AI and the future of science. To address this, we distinguish two types of novelty: distance, which measures how far a hypothesis lies from existing work, and direction, which captures whether the hypothesis pursues new lines of inquiry beyond those already present. These two measures diverge sharply for LLM-generated work. We represent scientific papers in a shared conceptual space using a pretrained scientific-paper embedding model. Within this space, we embed 26.9 million human-authored papers across 1,325 research topics in six natural-science fields and 524,308 LLM-generated hypotheses from eight models. Distance is measured using existing metrics. To quantify direction, we introduce the orthogonal novelty score (ONS). LLMs consistently generate ideas more distant from existing work than human-authored papers, up to 16\% further when the LLM is given the papers farthest from the centre of the topic. However, LLM hypotheses have a 15--23\% lower median ONS than published papers from the same topic. Thus, LLMs move further from what is already known, but remain within established directions. This pattern persists across changes in various configurations. As a result, LLMs excel at extending the frontier but the creation of new directions is still led by human scientists.
Chinese Translation
自主研究系统的成功取决于其生成的科学假设的质量。近期研究报告称，人类评审者常常将LLM生成的想法评为比人类专家的想法更具新颖性，这引发了AI能够加速科学发现的希望。然而，这些模型能否做到不只是扩展已有知识，仍不清楚。LLM能否通过揭示新的研究方向来推动真正的创新，还是仅限于重复并重新组合科学已知的内容？这个未解决的问题处于关于AI与科学未来的讨论的核心。为解决这一问题，我们区分两类新颖性：距离，衡量一个假设与已有工作的距离；方向，刻画该假设是否追求超越已有研究路线的新的探究方向。对于LLM生成的工作，这两种度量出现显著分歧。我们使用预训练的科学论文嵌入模型，将科学论文表示在一个共享的概念空间中。在该空间内，我们嵌入了来自六个自然科学领域、1,325个研究主题的2690万篇人类撰写的论文，以及来自八个模型的524,308条LLM生成的假设。距离使用现有指标来测量。为量化方向，我们引入正交新颖性得分（ONS）。LLM始终生成比人类撰写的论文与已有工作距离更远的想法；当向LLM提供距离主题中心最远的论文时，其距离可远出多达16\%。然而，LLM假设的ONS中位数比同一主题的已发表论文低15--23\%。因此，LLM离已知内容更远，但仍停留在既定方向之内。这种模式在多种配置的变化下持续存在。因此，LLM擅长扩展前沿，但新方向的创造仍由人类科学家主导。

cs.AI / 7 / 2610.17610
OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
OpenDepth：将图像编辑先验重新用于鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计
Mengke Zhang, Tianyi Yang, Xinzhuo Li, Anlong Ming
cs.AI
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.
Chinese Translation
最近，生成先验的引入已彻底改变了单目深度估计（MDE），以极高的数据效率实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能。然而，尽管基于文本到图像（T2I）模型的方法在一般场景中表现优异，但当面对开放世界环境扰动（如光照变化和恶劣天气）时，其有效性会急剧下降。由于 T2I 先验是为语义合成而非保留像素级结构而优化的，因此在剧烈视觉偏移下，它们难以将几何结构与外观解耦，容易引发结构性幻觉。因此，我们的核心见解是将开放世界深度估计建模为跨多风格图像的一致几何推断，充分利用图像到图像（I2I）模型强大的结构保持编辑先验。基于此，我们提出 OpenDepth，一个鲁棒的开放世界 MDE 框架，它引入了“域内感知”（Intra-Domain Awareness）——一种将共享相同几何结构的不同风格输入映射到统一潜在空间的能力。为了实现这一点，我们首先在扩散 Transformer（DiT）内对齐浅层特征，以将退化观测锚定到统一的几何表示。此外，我们引入一项联合 RGB 潜在重建任务，要求模型从退化输入中恢复干净的 RGB 信息。这种多阶段策略有效解耦了环境风格干扰，迫使模型严格关注底层几何恢复。广泛的评估表明，OpenDepth 在标准和极端天气基准上为鲁棒的零样本深度估计创造了新的 SOTA 记录，展现出卓越的结构完整性和适应性。

cs.AI / 8 / 2610.17613
MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification
MAS-Gate：通过以节点为中心的量化解锁多智能体系统生命周期
Hehai Lin, Zixuan Wang, Ming Yan, Peidong Wang, Shilei Cao, Minzhi Li, Bosheng Ding, Juepeng Zheng, Chengwei Qin
cs.AI · cs.MA
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. Modeling each execution as a directed acyclic graph, MAS-Gate combines within-node utility, which estimates a node's contribution through changes in reference-answer likelihood, with inter-node strength, which approximates semantic uptake and potential downstream reach. We adapt this shared quantification to three objectives: providing a structure-aware dense reward for Orchestrator training, training an Editor to act on execution prefixes using paired rewards from completed edited and unedited trajectories, and supplying risk-ranked nodes as auxiliary evidence for LLM-based post-hoc attribution. Experiments spanning interaction environments, knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, general reasoning, and post-hoc attribution demonstrate that MAS-Gate improves workflow construction, targeted runtime editing, and LLM-assisted error localization over corresponding phase-specific baselines. Together, these results establish MAS-Gate as a unified structural interface for improving MAS generation, dynamic editing, and error attribution throughout the lifecycle.
Chinese Translation
基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）能够通过分解任务并协调互补能力，解决单个智能体无法企及的复杂问题。尽管对 MAS 已有广泛研究，现有工作在很大程度上聚焦于其开发与运行中的特定方面或单个阶段，导致视角碎片化，其目标与信号难以在这些不同场景之间协调一致。为了弥合这些彼此割裂的视角，我们将 MAS 的开发与运行概念化为一个三阶段生命周期，涵盖执行前的设计时编排、执行期间的运行时干预，以及执行后的事后归因，并引入 MAS-Gate，一种可跨这些阶段适用的统一的以节点为中心的量化方法。MAS-Gate 将每次执行建模为有向无环图，并结合节点内效用与节点间强度：前者通过参考答案似然的变化来估计节点的贡献，后者近似语义吸收与潜在下游影响范围。我们将这一共享量化适配于三个目标：为 Orchestrator 训练提供结构感知的稠密奖励；训练一个 Editor，使其利用来自已完成的编辑后轨迹与未编辑轨迹的成对奖励，对执行前缀采取行动；以及提供按风险排序的节点，作为基于 LLM 的事后归因的辅助证据。跨越交互环境、知识密集型多跳问答、通用推理和事后归因的实验表明，MAS-Gate 在工作流构建、有针对性的运行时编辑以及 LLM 辅助的错误定位方面优于相应的特定阶段基线。这些结果共同确立了 MAS-Gate 作为一种统一的结构接口，用于在整个生命周期中改进 MAS 生成、动态编辑和错误归因。

Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents
智能体真的能遗忘吗？探索面向 LLM 智能体的机器遗忘
Junkai Lin, Ge Xu, Zheng Xu, Junkai Chen, Xiangyuan Lan
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong capabilities in interactive problem solving, tool use, and long-horizon task execution. However, they may also acquire sensitive or private knowledge during training and expose it during deployment. Retraining a model from scratch to remove such knowledge is prohibitively costly, making machine unlearning a more practical approach. Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted undesirable knowledge from trained models without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. When language models are deployed as agents, parameter-level unlearning becomes insufficient: forgotten information may still persist in memory artifacts or be reacquired via tool calls. In this paper, we formulate the problem of agent unlearning as removing private information from an LLM-based agent across three information channels: parametric knowledge, persistent memory, and tool-call acquisition. To study this problem, we introduce we introduce Agent Unlearning Benchmark (AUBench), a controlled benchmark that extends the fictitious-author setting of TOFU into an agent environment with persistent memory, an offline web snapshot, tool-accessible documents, and provenance-tracked interaction trajectories. By evaluating existing parameter-level and memory-level unlearning methods in this setting, AUBench reveals the gap between model-level forgetting and system-level agent unlearning, and provides a foundation for developing unlearning methods that operate across the full lifecycle of LLM agents.

大语言模型（LLM）智能体在交互式问题求解、工具使用和长时程任务执行方面已展现出强大的能力。然而，它们也可能在训练期间获取敏感或私密知识，并在部署期间将其暴露。从头重新训练模型以移除此类知识成本高得令人望而却步，这使得机器遗忘成为一种更实用的方法。机器遗忘旨在在无需从头重新训练的情况下，从已训练模型中移除目标性的不良知识，同时保持通用效用。当语言模型作为智能体部署时，参数级遗忘变得不够充分：被遗忘的信息可能仍留存于记忆产物中，或通过工具调用被重新获取。在本文中，我们将智能体遗忘问题形式化为：跨三个信息渠道从基于 LLM 的智能体中移除私密信息：参数化知识、持久记忆和工具调用获取。为研究这一问题，我们引入 我们引入 智能体遗忘基准（Agent Unlearning Benchmark，AUBench），这是一个受控基准，将 TOFU 的虚构作者设定扩展到具有持久记忆、离线网页快照、可通过工具访问的文档以及带有来源追溯的交互轨迹的智能体环境中。通过在该设定中评估现有的参数级和记忆级遗忘方法，AUBench 揭示了模型级遗忘与系统级智能体遗忘之间的差距，并为开发能够在 LLM 智能体全生命周期中运行的遗忘方法提供了基础。

Chao Li, Renhe Jiang, Chuan Xiao, Jiawei Wang
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for human mobility generation by modeling individual routines, activities, and mobility preferences. However, existing approaches remain largely resident-centric: generating realistic individual trajectories does not necessarily recover the encounters that emerge when multiple residents co-occur at the same place and time. To this end, we study encounter-aware human mobility generation, which jointly preserves individual mobility and population-level interaction structure. We propose EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework consisting of a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework. The Encounter Generator first captures city-level encounter rhythms and then instantiates participant-time-venue encounters, while the Iterative Coupling Framework coordinates these encounters with personal mobility behavior through successive refinement. We further introduce an encounter recovery protocol covering encounter marginal and joint distributions over residents, times, and venues. Experiments on the Japan and NYC datasets show that EncounterMob outperforms all external baselines on all seven encounter metrics and all six personal mobility metrics. Compared with ELLMob, it reduces the participant-time-venue joint error by 40.4%/41.7% and the mean personal mobility error by 58.8%/32.7% on Japan/NYC, respectively.

cs.AI / 11 / 2610.17689
Stable Token-level Scheduling for Serverless LLM Inference
面向无服务器 LLM 推理的稳定 Token 级调度
Hardi Ashishbhai Desai, Balaji N K, Sourav Kanti Addya
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Serverless inference is emerging as an efficient deployment model for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its ability to elastically scale resources, improve GPU utilization through resource sharing, and reduce infrastructure costs. However, existing approaches primarily optimize time to first token (TTFT) while overlooking inter-token latency (ITL), a key determinant of user experience during response generation. We observe that LLM inference comprises a computation-intensive prefill stage and a bandwidth-bound decode stage, where admitting new requests can disrupt ongoing decoding and increase latency. To address this, we propose Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level instead of the batch level. TWP dynamically adjusts a selfregulating token window and incorporates chunk-based prefill to minimize interference from incoming requests. Experiments on realistic serverless workloads show that TWP delivers stable TTFT, significantly reduces latency spikes, lowers P99 tail latency, minimizes ITL variation, and improves throughput by up to 45% over ServerlessLLM and 58% over conventional schedulers. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven tokenlevel scheduling enables stable, high-throughput serverless LLM inference without modifying the underlying model.
Chinese Translation
无服务器推理正在成为一种高效的大语言模型（LLM）部署模式，因为它能够弹性伸缩资源、通过资源共享提升 GPU 利用率并降低基础设施成本。然而，现有方法主要优化首 token 延迟（TTFT），却忽视了 token 间延迟（ITL），而后者是响应生成过程中用户体验的关键决定因素。我们观察到，LLM 推理由计算密集的预填充（prefill）阶段和带宽受限的解码（decode）阶段组成，其中接纳新请求会干扰正在进行的解码并增加延迟。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Token 窗口节流（Token Window Pacing, TWP），这是一个闭环调度框架，它利用来自 ITL、队列深度和工作负载特征的运行时反馈，在 token 级而非批次级调控请求接纳。TWP 动态调整一个自我调节的 token 窗口，并引入基于分块的预填充，以最小化新到请求带来的干扰。在真实的无服务器工作负载上的实验表明，TWP 能够提供稳定的 TTFT、显著减少延迟尖峰、降低 P99 尾部延迟、最小化 ITL 波动，并且相较于 ServerlessLLM 将吞吐量提升最高达 45%，相较于传统调度器提升最高达 58%。这些结果表明，反馈驱动的 token 级调度能够在不修改底层模型的情况下实现稳定、高吞吐的无服务器 LLM 推理。

cs.AI / 12 / 2610.17740
Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery
面向科学方程发现的耦合工具框架--模型演化
Pengze Li, Jiaquan Zhang, Encheng Su, Yunbo Long, Zihang Zeng, Xinping Liu, Han Zhang, Junchi Yu, Shixiang Tang, Aoran Wang, Xi Chen
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.

大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于从实验数据中发现科学方程。这样的发现系统有两个必须协同工作的部分：一个可执行计算工具库，以及模型的工具使用策略。工具提供求解能力，从诊断数据中的结构到拟合候选方程；策略则规划和编排它们的使用。然而，现有系统只调整其中一个部分，要么保持工具集固定，要么保持模型固定，这使得相应的失败无法被纠正。我们开发了一个耦合演化框架，它从同一个可验证的拟合误差信号改进这两个部分。在工具演化阶段，一个智能体通过诊断自身失败，从一小组通用数值操作中生长出一个可执行工具库：当缺少某项能力时，它编写一个新工具；当正确的工具未被使用时，它修订其选择规则。在策略演化阶段，一个小型开放模型（约 3B 活跃参数）在使用冻结工具库收集的成功工具使用轨迹上，以及在经过筛选以与所有评估基准不相交的训练公式上进行微调。消融实验表明这两个阶段是互补的：在完全没有工具库时，同一个模型几乎什么都解不出来，工具贡献了大部分增益，而轨迹训练带来了进一步增益，该增益在最困难的问题上最大。完整系统在拟合容差 $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$ 下解决了 79.1/71.3% 的 LSR-Synth 问题，在分布不同的 SRSD-Feynman 面板上达到 63.8% 的汇总准确率，并获得 $-7.27$ 的归一化 CP3-28 聚合值。这些结果提示了一种更广泛的科学智能体配方：让模型及其工具在可验证反馈下相互改进。

cs.AI / 13 / 2610.17757
Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents
指令是证据，而非目标：衡量智能体的结果对齐
Kaiming Liu, Yuxuan Liu, Jinrui Ju, Minyuan Ruan, Xuanyu Lei, Peng Li, Yang Liu
cs.AI · cs.SE
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model agents can follow complex human instructions to solve real-world tasks. In practice, however, initial instructions are often incomplete. In our analysis of 100 user-agent trajectories from SWE-chat, 56\% of initial instructions omit requirements that later emerge as necessary, and 52\% of the useful follow-up requirements could have been inferred from the project. A user states requirements from their own understanding of the task, and these \textbf{stated requirements} often differ from the \textbf{true requirements} that completing the task imposes. An agent should therefore treat the instruction as evidence rather than as the objective, inferring the true requirements from the instruction and the environment and satisfying them even when the user is not yet aware of all of them. We call this ability \textbf{outcome alignment}. In this work, we construct \textbf{TiGanEval}, a benchmark of software engineering and research tasks. In every task the user genuinely lacks part of the requirements, each requirement stays discoverable from the code and runtime behaviour of the environment, and requirements the agent infers are separated from those the user adds after observing delivered work. These properties together make outcome alignment measurable. Evaluating eight frontier models including GPT-5.6-Sol, we find outcome alignment broadly missing: the models lose 53 to 67 points of success rate when moving from the full specification to the partial instruction, and consequence feedback across four submissions does not close the gap. Furthermore, a plan-mode harness cannot compensate for the missing ability of the model itself, which places outcome alignment among the abilities the next generation of models should be developed for.

大语言模型智能体能够遵循复杂的人类指令来解决现实世界任务。然而在实践中，初始指令往往是不完整的。在我们对来自 SWE-chat 的 100 条用户-智能体轨迹的分析中，56% 的初始指令遗漏了后来才变得必要的要求，并且 52% 的有用后续要求本可以从项目中推断出来。用户根据自己对任务的理解来陈述需求，而这些“陈述的需求”往往不同于完成任务所强加的“真实需求”。因此，智能体应当将指令视为证据，而不是目标，从指令和环境中推断出真实需求，并满足这些需求，即使用户尚未意识到其中所有需求。我们将这种能力称为“结果对齐”。在这项工作中，我们构建了 TiGanEval，一个由软件工程和研究任务组成的基准。在每个任务中，用户确实缺少部分需求，每项需求都始终可以从代码和环境的运行时行为中发现，并且智能体推断出的需求与用户在观察到交付工作后添加的需求被分离开来。这些属性共同使结果对齐变得可衡量。通过评估包括 GPT-5.6-Sol 在内的八个前沿模型，我们发现结果对齐普遍缺失：当从完整规范转向部分指令时，这些模型会损失 53 到 67 个百分点的成功率，而跨四次提交的后果反馈并不能弥合这一差距。此外，计划模式测试框架无法弥补模型自身缺失的能力，这使结果对齐成为下一代模型应当为之开发的能力之一。

cs.AI / 14 / 2610.17869
ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
ECMR：面向多智能体 LLM 推理的证据感知审议控制
Yuan Liu, Haoyue Peng, Fanliang Hu, Lei Huang, Wenli Cai
cs.AI · cs.MA
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.
Chinese Translation
多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统通常在推理之前就确定一种审议协议。固定协议无法向已解决的实例和未解决的实例分配不同的计算量，并且可能把重复的支持误当作独立的确证。我们将这一失效现象作为语义虚假共识来研究：一个自信的群体答案，其依据却是狭窄、重复或相关的理由。我们提出 ECMR，一个作用于冻结的角色条件化 LLM 之上的证据感知控制器。在每一步，ECMR 汇总答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史以及剩余预算，然后选择是提出、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠正某个角色，还是停止。我们将这一决策形式化为有限时域预算控制，并推导出充分条件，在这些条件下，状态条件化、风险触发式验证和角色纠正能够提升成本调整后的效用。在一项声明的留出评估中，针对来自 MedQA、CaseHOLD 和 FinQA 的 9,000 条记录，ECMR-Full 将汇总准确率从 62.1% 提升至 84.9%，将虚假共识率从 40.7% 降低至 17.0%，并将证据支持率从 58.0% 提升至 88.7%。状态打乱在仅减少 0.7 轮的情况下损失了 11.7 个准确率点，而更困难的轨迹则从提前停止转向仲裁。ECMR-Full 使用了最大的 token 预算，从而带来最强的绝对可靠性，而非全面更优的 token 效率。

cs.AI / 15 / 2610.17893
Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
使用可验证信息奖励训练大型语言模型进行多智能体协作
Keru Chen, Sen Lin, Yingbin Liang, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Shaofeng Zou
cs.AI · cs.CL · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

cs.AI / 16 / 2610.18052
Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents
当被要求时，智能体能遗忘吗？一个用于LLM智能体记忆遗忘的基准
Bofan Xie, Chaokun Wang, Guanchen Ge, Songyao Wang, Fang Niu, Hang Zhang, Wei Wang
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.
Chinese Translation
长期记忆已成为大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心组成部分。随着智能体在长期使用中积累个人信息，用户越来越频繁地要求它们删除敏感或过时的事实。记忆系统应当遵从此类请求。它应当精确删除被请求删除的内容，并保持其余记忆完好无损。然而，现有记忆基准仅评估记忆写入、检索和组织，因此智能体能否在用户明确要求时遗忘仍未得到充分评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出Bemula，这是首个专门面向记忆遗忘的基准。它包含50个多会话对话实例、6种类型的135个遗忘请求，以及1,742个测试问题。每个对话都有一个不含这些请求的对照版本，因此只有已经存储了目标信息的系统才能因遗忘而获得得分。在这些配对版本上，五个测试套件衡量存储、删除被请求信息、保留无关记忆、重新学习相似事实，以及抵御提取攻击的能力。在Bemula上，我们评估了三种骨干LLM下的六个主流记忆系统，并在其中两种上同时评估了Full Context LLM。结果是负面的。在所有被评估的系统和骨干LLM中，没有任何系统能够端到端通过超过1.5%的遗忘请求，而大多数系统一个都通不过。这些系统要么使被请求的信息在简单攻击下仍可被提取，要么删除远超请求范围的内容。因此，记忆遗忘仍然是智能体记忆设计中的一个开放挑战。我们在 https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark 发布了数据和代码。

cs.AI / 17 / 2610.18141
Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs
通过纠正全模态大型语言模型中的模态误路由来缓解跨模态幻觉
Yu Mi, Licheng Pan, Jiayi Zhu, Qirui Liu, Yitong Qiao, Changtong Xu, Tao Wei, Fei Sun, Zhixuan Chu, Kui Ren
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.
Chinese Translation
全模态大型语言模型（OLLMs）在音视频干扰下容易产生跨模态幻觉。我们发现，对于相当一部分不正确的联合预测，与问题相关的单模态分支仍然能够恢复出正确答案，这表明即使任务相关证据未在联合预测中体现出来，它仍可能从相关模态中恢复。我们将这种可恢复的失败模式称为 \emph{模态误路由}。我们提出 CaRe（冲突感知残差干预），一种无需训练的推理时方法，用于识别并纠正模态误路由。CaRe 使用纯文本模态探针来识别一个候选的特定模态反事实分支，并在其预测与原始联合预测冲突时标记潜在的误路由。对于此类情况，CaRe 根据反事实表示与融合表示之间的差异计算一个残差方向，并用其将原始多模态状态引导向相关模态证据，同时在原始音视频推理路径中保留两种模态。干预强度根据反事实分支的置信度进行自适应调整。在两个 OLLM 上针对 CMM 和 AVHBench 的实验表明，CaRe 始终优于所评估的推理时幻觉缓解基线。

cs.AI / 18 / 2610.18168
Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics
回到未来：面向长时程粒子动力学的反向结果建模
Leyan Zhang, Nantian He, Jiajun Ma, Yanpeng Zhao, Yunbo Wang
cs.AI
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.
Chinese Translation
物体轨迹的准确预测是机械理解与机器人控制的基础。然而，自回归模型本质上会受到累积误差的影响，导致长时程推演中出现严重漂移。观察到在许多具有耗散或趋于静止行为的物理系统中，最终状态通常比瞬态动力学更可预测（例如，滑动物体在摩擦下静止，或单摆稳定在平衡位置），我们提出了 ReStep，一种反转传统前向预测范式的级联方法。ReStep 首先采用随机模型直接预测最终状态，然后利用 Anchored Diffusion 生成以目标为条件的中间轨迹。通过以两个“边界状态”为条件，它有效约束了动力学并减少了不确定性，从而产生物理上合理且时间上连贯的过渡。我们进一步将 ReStep 动力学作为物理引擎集成到 3D Gaussian Splatting 流程中，从而实现一个统一的物理-视觉框架，用于从图像进行直观推理。在多样的刚性和非刚性碰撞数据集上进行的大量实验表明，ReStep 实现了更优的长期准确性，并通过反向结果建模显著缓解了误差累积。

Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate
超越答案共享：面向多智能体辩论中定向同伴参与的 TrueMAD
Dezheng Bao, Sihang Du, Renhong Huang, Zhizhang Yuan, Yifei Sun, Yang Yang
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.
Chinese Translation
多智能体辩论（MAD）旨在通过让智能体接触替代解决方案并支持迭代式修正，来提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，标准的广播式 MAD 只是让同伴的答案可见，却不要求智能体针对某一特定的同伴主张进行深入互动。因此，可靠的推理可能被冲突性回应或多数派回应所压制，从而限制可达的性能，而错误推理则可能在缺乏可操作反馈的情况下持续存在并损害最终预测。我们提出 TrueMAD，这是一种与骨干模型无关的测试时插件，在答案广播与自我修正之间引入一对一、自由形式的同伴建议。每个来源智能体通过支持、反驳、细化或进一步提问来回应目标智能体当前的推理，而目标智能体则保留对如何修正的控制权。同一机制无需参数更新即可增强标准 MAD 及其改进变体。在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond 和 TruthfulQA 上，使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 时，TrueMAD 相较 MAD 将智能体级准确率和严格多数准确率平均分别提升 3.62 和 3.52 个百分点，而 TrueDMAD 相较 DMAD 分别提升 4.72 和 4.06 个百分点。在话语、智能体转换和群体层面的分析进一步表明，出现了更多针对特定同伴的审议、更多以纠正为导向的修正，以及更有利的共识动态。

cs.AI / 20 / 2610.18298
Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
输出纪律设定下限：一个证伪引导、模型无关的智能体协议，用于可审计的假设驱动决策
Jing Liu, Yongxing Qi, Ping Yao, Ting Wu
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.
Chinese Translation
在可审计、假设驱动的决策任务中——每一个候选都可以对照证据进行检验——究竟是什么在约束大语言模型？在公开的中医证候辨证 TCMEval-SDT 基准（200 例）上，真正的约束是输出纪律与推理结构，而不仅仅是模型能力：两年的模型规模扩展仅使零样本得分变动 -0.03 至 +0.08，而输出纪律失效（推理不终止、格式不合规、运行间波动大）即使在前沿模型中也持续存在。我们用一个模型无关的智能体框架对此进行检验，该框架将决策形式化为一个五阶段闭环，并由候选×证据矩阵证伪协议加以强制执行：每一个候选都要对照每一条证据进行评判，在结论被允许给出之前，必须至少有半数的候选被证伪，而存活下来的候选则以机器可验证的单行格式输出。在五个基础模型上，该效应的正负取决于零样本输出纪律：它挽救了输出纪律失效的模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash：+0.267/+0.271，完全来自终止性挽救），将某个高方差模型的运行间标准差从 0.218 降至 0.007（Kimi K3），同时对已经具备纪律的模型造成显著代价（在预算匹配的 Qwen3-4B/32B 上为 -0.087 至 -0.120）。消融实验将该代价归因于受候选约束的格式层，并表明该效应与注入的知识内容无关（协议—知识解耦）。该协议还可迁移至抗错误信息的数学推理，以 89.8% 的召回率和 6.8% 的假阳性率检测出注入的虚假前提（MCC 0.54；“全部标记”基线得分为 0），并将准确率恢复到无误导信息时的上限。在零样本输出纪律薄弱之处，推理协议设定下限；而基础模型的能力始终设定上限。

Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction
通过潜在双假设推理与按需轨迹重建实现的高效安全护栏
Md Asiful Islam, Fahmida Alam, Mihai Surdeanu
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. Experiments show that LR-Guard outperforms its explicit-reasoning teacher in most in-domain and out-of-domain settings on safety classification and explanation extraction, while achieving a 19.4x inference speedup at batch size one. Further, reconstructed reasoning traces from the latent information exhibit high semantic similarity to the teacher's explicit reasoning.
Chinese Translation
依赖基于推理的大语言模型（LLM）的护栏方法改进了安全决策，但由于显式推理而带来大量的推理开销。我们提出 LR-Guard（潜在推理护栏），一种高效且可解释的护栏，它联合学习结构化的潜在推理与按需推理重建。我们的方法将冻结教师模型对安全与不安全提示解读及其比较的分析蒸馏为紧凑的潜在表示。联合训练针对安全预测和教师显式推理轨迹的重建来优化这些表示，从而无需为每个决策生成中间文本即可实现人类可读的解释。实验表明，LR-Guard 在大多数域内和域外设置下，在安全分类和解释提取方面均优于其显式推理教师模型，同时在批大小为一时实现了 19.4 倍的推理加速。此外，从潜在信息中重建的推理轨迹与教师的显式推理表现出很高的语义相似度。

cs.AI / 22 / 2610.18354
Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
为策略性智能体交互选择大型语言模型
Arastun Mammadli, Herbert Woisetschläger, Jawad Fayaz, Shiqiang Wang
cs.AI · cs.IR · cs.MA
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs $N$ compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model's strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.
Chinese Translation
博弈论基准声称，大型语言模型（LLM）的策略性决策会因博弈类型、交互结构和能力维度的不同而变化。然而，它们仅在单个固定模型上评估策略性表现。与此并行的是，当代的 LLM 路由器在质量—成本权衡下选择模型，但缺乏策略结构的概念。它们没有考虑一个可能未知、且会随时间适应并改变反馈信号的对手。为解决这一问题，我们扩展了博弈论评估，并将策略性选择定义为叠加在基础博弈之上的元博弈。在每一轮中，策略性选择器从模型组合中派出一个 LLM，以应对一个潜在且在线学习的博弈收益矩阵。我们发现评估信号具有博弈特异性，并且与传统基准测试设置相比，提取可靠信号需要多得多的种子运行次数 $N$。通过在 5 种博弈和 10 个 LLM 上进行评估，我们表明模型的策略能力会因博弈设置和所面对对手的不同而存在显著差异。在此基础上，我们实现了一套选择器方法，并发现依赖查询嵌入或 LLM 自我反思的方法无法稳定地捕捉潜在的策略信号。一种轻量级多臂老虎机算法在各种博弈中表现更为可靠，尽管它仍不及最佳的固定模型。最后，我们表明简单的非平稳与对抗性老虎机变体未能超越平稳老虎机基线，这指出现有方法在处理策略环境中不断变化的对手方面存在缺口。

cs.AI / 23 / 2610.18566
Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection
重新思考大语言模型路由中的质量：安全条件化的模型与预算选择
Yichi Zhang, Zhenxiang Huang, Yuyang Zhang, Yuchen Yang
cs.AI · cs.CR
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets. We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型（LLM）路由器通过为每个查询选择调用哪个模型以及给予它多少输出 token，来降低服务成本。现有路由器使用单一质量指标对模型-预算动作进行排序。这对于混合负载并不适用。对于普通查询，好的回答是正确且有用的（效用）；对于安全敏感的查询，好的回答会拒绝有害请求或抵御恶意指令（安全性）。这两个目标偏好不同的模型和预算。我们提出 SCRouter，一个学习何时优先考虑安全性以及如何分配 token 预算的路由器。对于每个模型-预算对，它估计响应在预算内完成的概率。它利用这一概率分别预测效用和安全性。一个小的探测模块决定如何为每个查询对这两个预测进行加权。SCRouter 随后通过权衡加权后的效用和安全性相对于成本，来选择模型和预算。我们还构建了 SCRouterBench，这是一个包含 38,869 条效用与安全性查询、涵盖九个安全维度的基准，每条查询都在 12 个模型和 12 个预算的全部 144 种组合下得到回答，外加 2,753 条域外查询。SCRouter 在域内将基线提升了 13-29 个点，在域外提升了 19-23 个点。

cs.AI / 24 / 2610.18567
Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix
配置RAG系统：什么会出问题、问题源自哪里，以及如何修复
Liangyu Chen, Youpeng Ma, Yulong Ye, Zezhen Xiang, Tao Chen
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.
Chinese Translation
检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种通过将大型语言模型（LLM）与向量/图数据库等其他组件交织来改进大型语言模型的主流范式。因此，所得的RAG系统通常具有高度可配置性，而在这种可配置性下，相当数量的故障与配置相关。然而，对于RAG系统的配置问题，仍缺乏系统性的理解。为弥合这一空白，本文中，我们开展了首次大规模实证研究，研究对象是从10个多样化RAG系统中收集的654个真实世界配置问题。基于此，我们提供了RAG系统配置问题的症状、根因、相关阶段和修复模式的完整分类，以及若干新观察。我们的发现不仅揭示了配置问题的特征，还将它们与RAG独特的流水线阶段紧密联系起来，例如，我们发现大多数症状可以在早期或晚期阶段被观察到，而根因所在的阶段可能与识别出症状的阶段并不相同。我们还向从业者提供了九条可操作见解，用于测试、定位和修复RAG系统的配置问题。

LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
通过结构化配方优化实现自动化后训练的 LLM 智能体
Ruohong Liu, Bohan Tang, Lekang Jiang, Jack Umenberger, Yiwen Guo
cs.AI · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.
Chinese Translation
自动化后训练通过在有限的实验预算下，自动构建并优化一个由数据来源、数据处理、跨域组合和训练配置上的耦合决策所组成的配方，将预训练大语言模型（LLM）转化为能够处理多样领域的模型。现有的自动化方法要么搜索预定义的配方空间，这类空间能够实现系统化优化，但保持固定不变，而不会使其可选选择适应目标任务；要么使用开放式智能体，这类智能体能够发现任务特定的选择，但将其隐含在试验级别的编辑之中，限制了它们在多次试验之间的系统性复用与重组。为填补这一空白，我们引入了对任务自适应配方空间的优化，这是一种新颖的范式，能够使配方空间本身适应目标任务，同时显式地表示其选择，以支持系统性复用、重组和联合优化。我们以结构化配方优化（SRO）来实例化这一范式，它包含一个基于 LLM 的配方空间设计器，用于构建任务自适应的配方空间，以及一个多域配方优化器，利用结构化的试验证据来指导 LLM 候选构建和多目标贝叶斯试验选择。大量实验表明，SRO 在所有被评估的目标模型与智能体-LLM 组合中都取得了最高的平均分。在跨三个能力域和六个基准的联合后训练中，SRO 在 Qwen3-1.7B 搭配 GPT-5.4 上达到 41.1，而最强基线为 15.4；在 Qwen3-4B 搭配 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上达到 53.8，而最强基线为 40.8。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO 获取。

Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
超越答案投票：通过跨采样轨迹的图对齐对LLM推理进行细粒度纠正
Haotian Liu, Yingjian Chen, Xiaohang Xu, Lang Huang, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Irene Li
cs.AI · cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型越来越多地处理需要多步推理的任务，其中中间论断中的错误可能影响最终答案。自洽性（SC）通过对采样的最终答案进行投票来改进推理，但其投票会使中间分歧得不到解决。为解决这一问题，我们提出DDRG（Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs，由推理图引导的分歧驱动验证），一个从冻结的推理轨迹库中进行选择性纠正的框架。我们的洞见是，图对齐能够暴露论断级分歧，并在不扩展采样轨迹库的情况下提供纠正证据。DDRG构建有来源依据的论断图，并将局部化冲突发送给答案盲验证器。由验证器支持的、到达多数答案支持路径的反驳会触发一次聚焦修复；否则，DDRG返回精确的SC投票结果。在五个基准上的实验结果表明，原生零样本DDRG在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上相较于直接回答，将宏平均准确率分别提高了8.65和15.83个百分点。在该宏指标上，它也超过了CoT、所评估的GoT和GoV问答适配方法以及SC。DDRG将局部验证与选择性纠正联系起来，而不会扩大初始候选库。

cs.AI / 27 / 2610.18760
Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
超越裁决：基于可验证反馈的智能体代码评判
Zheye Deng, Sha Li, Changlong Yu, Xin Liu, Qin Lu, Priyanka Nigam, Yangqiu Song
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型（LLMs）的测试时扩展可以涉及生成多个候选解以供选择，或修订早先的尝试。为了指导选择与修订，我们需要一个验证器，它能够估计候选解的正确性并提供失败证据。然而，在竞赛编程中，官方评判系统在有限的提交预算下提供权威裁决，而不揭示失败解释或导致失败的输入。为了在不消耗官方提交的情况下提供有信息量的反馈，我们提出了一项任务：模型仅使用题目陈述和源代码来评判并诊断候选程序，生成的计数例作为可核查的证据。为评估该任务，我们从 USACO 2026 竞赛构建了 USACO-JUDGE，使用由人类专家和多个 LLM 编写的被接受和未被接受的程序。然后，我们在一个通用执行沙箱中，通过强化学习训练了 ARBITER，这是一个 35B 的专家混合（MoE）智能体验证器。训练将错误程序上的反例成功率从 40.61% 提高到 62.67%，并将 USACO-JUDGE 上的平均二值裁决准确率从 71.41% 提高到 87.41%，接近前沿验证性能。除验证之外，ARBITER 在代码选择和代码改进方面均优于基线。在一项 IOI 2026 案例研究中，ARBITER 引导的改进在官方提交限制下将 GPT-OSS-120B 的期望分数提高到金牌阈值以上。

cs.AI / 28 / 2610.18780
BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
BLADE：审计信息使用以进行LLM多智能体系统中的失败归因
Xiaoguang Guo, Yaohao Long, Chuxu Zhang
cs.AI · cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型多智能体系统通过跨专门角色、工具和工作流的协作，扩展了单个智能体的能力。然而，协作使失败更难以诊断：一个智能体可能误解一个正确的结果，而其他智能体则将该错误继续向前传递。因此，失败归因旨在识别应负责的智能体和决定性的错误步骤。近期方法追踪依赖关系，但知道信息来自哪里并不等同于知道它在哪里出错。我们提出BLADE（Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence，基于审计依赖证据的责任定位），这是一个无需训练的框架，它超越了追踪信息，转向审计信息的使用。BLADE使用Jev进行结构化概率判断，并利用依赖概率来选择相关的源决策交接点进行审计。在这些交接点，它检查接收决策是否忠实于其来源且在任务要求范围内使用来源，从而区分错误引入、错误传播和错误修复。这些发现为考虑所有执行步骤的全局诊断提供信息。在没有参考答案的情况下，BLADE在共享Jev决策接口下，在五个Who&When和Who&When Pro子集上的1,228次失败运行中，于八种策略之间取得最佳或并列最佳的步骤准确率，比All-at-once高出2.2–11.1个百分点。使责任证据显式化，为更可解释且更可靠的智能体系统提供了一条路径。

cs.AI / 29 / 2610.18820
Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
在模型生成之前先读懂场合
Muyao Kong, Zhihao Lin
cs.AI · cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型（LLM）通常依赖采样温度来调节其输出中的随机性程度。主流的温度选择方法通常采用固定的、启发式的全局设置以及上下文级或词元级的校准，而非一种具有几何可解释性的交际情境表征。在本工作中，我们引入了一个简单且可解释的温度选择框架，即\textbf{Scenario-Actor}，它使解码过程适应于所推断出的情境特征。Scenario-Actor 从 Transformer 隐藏状态中提取与情境相关的结构，并根据情境嵌入（scenario embedding）——一种对交际场景的结构化几何表征——来确定温度。实证结果表明，在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，与多个基线相比，Scenario-Actor 在交互式社交场景中取得了很强的目标完成性能，在开放式指令遵循上取得了显著提升，并在多轮对话上取得了有竞争力的性能。

cs.AI / 30 / 2610.18851
MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
MFG：多轮反馈引导的分子优化
Trieu Nguyen, Frazier N. Baker, Ruoxi Gao, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Xia Ning
cs.AI · cs.LG · q-bio.QM
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).
Chinese Translation

cs.CL / 31 / 2610.17363
UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
UMCR：通过指南整合与智能体链接实现通用医学概念识别
Fabrice Lamarche, Amal Zouaq
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.

cs.CL / 32 / 2610.17375
PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
PIG：用于加速扩散语言模型的并行不一致性引导
Quentin Fruytier, Anton Xue, Sanjay Shakkottai, Sujay Sanghavi
cs.CL
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.

Adib Sakhawat, Fardeen Sadab, Tamjid Hasan Fahim, Multazam Mahmud, Tahsan Ferdous Lihan, Md Isfak Iqbal Chowdhury, Nafis Ahnaf Jamil, Md. Atik Shahriar, Sieam Shahriare, Wasi Omar Syed, M Safwan Hasan Khan, Tabib Hassan
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

Decouple to Forget: Semantic Mediation for Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models
解耦以遗忘：大型语言模型中敏感遗忘的语义中介
Jingyue Cong, Andy Song, Yang Yu, Tabinda Sarwar, Xinshu Li, Ziqi Xu, Xun Yi, Ke Wang, Bo Han, Estrid He
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Machine unlearning for large language models seeks to remove specified knowledge while preserving general capability, yet current methods often treat an entire response as the unit of forgetting. This coarse granularity causes unnecessary utility loss when the forget target is only a small set of sensitive facts embedded within otherwise benign explanations. In this paper, we introduce Decouple to Forget (D2F), a targeted unlearning method inspired by semantic mediation that separates sensitive factual content from non-sensitive meaning and surface expression. For each example to be forgotten, D2F extracts a fact-level "mediator" representation from the answer, identifies which parts are sensitive, and removes only those parts while leaving the rest of the structure intact. We then generate counterfactual answers grounded in this mediator that preserve non-sensitive content but exclude sensitive facts, employing preference-based contrastive optimization to reduce the likelihood of information leakage while maintaining helpfulness and fluency. Experiments across various benchmark datasets show that D2F achieves a better balance between forgetting and retention than strong baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/D2F.

Encoding Context into LLM Weights: What Makes It Context?
将上下文编码进LLM权重：是什么使其成为上下文？
Yue Wang, Qizhou Wang, Feng Liu, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Bo Han
cs.CL · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Longer contexts allow large language models (LLMs) to condition their predictions on more information, but inference costs grow prohibitively with context length. An emerging alternative uses test-time updates to encode context as temporary changes to model weights. However, encoding this information into weights that already represent general knowledge obscures its role as context, so the LLM may fail to use it properly to condition subsequent inference. To restore this contextual role, we first associate each context with an identifier during encoding, thereby distinguishing the newly encoded information from pre-existing knowledge. Invoking the identifier at inference then enables the LLM to recite the encoded context. Nevertheless, successful recitation does not ensure that the LLM will use the recalled information as context. We therefore further introduce a prompting framework that explicitly guides the LLM to use this information as context. Across diverse controlled tasks and practical benchmarks, our method outperformed the baseline using only off-the-shelf LLMs, showing its advances in context encoding.

Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
超越信念嵌套：重新思考大型语言模型中的高阶心理理论
Shanshan You, Zhengqi Wang, Hao Liu, Yuqin Liu, Ya He, Xin Hao, Liyuan Wang
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria
GENDIS：来自印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚的多语言YouTube评论中的性别相关话语与立场
Luise Koch, Manuel Tonneau, Niyati Malhotra, Sunny Rai, Ana Maria Munoz Boudet, Victor Orozco-Olvera, Samuel P. Fraiberger, Sharath Chandra Guntuku
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.

Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言建模
Chen Chen, Pin-Jui Ku, Ankita Pasad, Ante Jukić, Zhehuai Chen, Boris Ginsburg
cs.CL
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.
